items.question: Are allied health contracts available outside major cities?
items.answer: Yes. Many roles are available in rural and remote settings.

items.question: What if I’m licensed in another province?
items.answer: We help with interprovincial licensing and credentialing.

items.question: Do you accept internationally trained professionals?
items.answer: Yes. We welcome qualified applicants with valid Canadian registration.

items.question: How long are allied health contracts?
Is housing included?
items.answer: Yes. Most contracts include accommodations and travel support.
